name: cancel_trial_auto_renewal
description: Cancel the auto-renewal of the Higgsfield MCP 3-day free Plus trial. Call this when the user asks to cancel the trial, cancel auto-renewal, stop the upcoming charge, or asks how to cancel. IMPORTANT SEMANTICS: cancelling stops the automatic charge at the end of the trial ONLY — the user KEEPS trial access and remaining trial credits until the trial ends; nothing is charged. First call WITHOUT `confirm` (or confirm=false): in UI clients this opens a confirmation card with 'Keep trial with auto-renewal' and 'Cancel auto-renewal' buttons; in text-only clients relay `assistant_response` verbatim and wait for the user's explicit confirmation. Only call again with `confirm=true` after the user explicitly confirmed the cancellation in chat. Never pass confirm=true on the first call.

confirm.description: false (default): show the cancellation confirmation (widget in UI clients, question in text clients) — always start here. true: actually cancel auto-renewal — pass ONLY after the user explicitly confirmed the cancellation in chat (text-only clients; in UI clients the widget button confirms).

initial_view.description: Tells the plans widget to render the cancel-confirmation card.

trial_status.description: Current trial state backing the confirmation copy.

eligible.description: True when the user can still start the trial.

status.description: Trial lifecycle state, e.g. 'active'. Null when the user never interacted with the trial.

trial_ends_at.description: ISO timestamp when the trial ends / the saved card is auto-charged.

trial_credits.description: Remaining MCP-only trial credits. Null when no trial was ever started.

then_price_cents.description: Price that would be auto-charged after the trial, in cents.

currency.description: ISO currency code for then_price_cents; absent means USD.

cancelled.description: True when auto-renewal was cancelled by this call (confirm=true path).

assistant_response.description: Ready-to-send response. Relay verbatim in text-only clients.

request_id.description: MCP server HTTP request ID for support/debugging.
